seo.title: QuantFlow — The edge isn't invented. It's observed.
seo.description: QuantFlow measures which proven trading rules are currently working and allocates capital by statistical conviction. A belief-updating engine for MOEX and Bybit, built on Schwager's rules — not invented alpha.

hero.subline: QuantFlow doesn't predict markets. It measures which proven trading rules are currently working and sizes every position by statistical conviction alone.

hero.caption: Signal propagation through the trading engine

footer.tagline2: Built on statistical belief, not invented alpha.

telegramBot.heading: Runs where you already are
telegramBot.intro: The Telegram bot is the operator surface, not a marketing add-on. Every strategy status change, fill and drawdown alert reaches you there, and every switch you can flip on the dashboard has a Telegram equivalent.
telegramBot.feature1Body: Position opened, position closed, strategy frozen. The same event dispatcher that writes to the trade ledger fans out to Telegram.
telegramBot.feature2Body: Check balances, review open positions, pause a strategy. Inline keyboards, no command syntax to memorize.
telegramBot.feature3Body: The dashboard and the bot read the same platform state. Nothing in the bot is a simplified or delayed copy.

brokerIntegrations.heading: Real accounts, real brokers
brokerIntegrations.intro: Orders route through actual broker APIs, not a simulated matching engine dressed up as one. Sandbox mode exists precisely so you can verify that before risking capital.
brokerIntegrations.tinkoffBody: MOEX equities and derivatives. Sandbox and live modes share one client.
brokerIntegrations.bybitBody: Crypto spot and derivatives, for strategies scoped to that market.
brokerIntegrations.finamBody: A second MOEX route, kept independent from the Tinkoff client.

sandbox.heading: Paper trade before it's real
sandbox.intro: The paper trading engine executes the exact same signal path as live trading, against simulated fills instead of a broker. It's how a strategy earns its way onto the live strategy layer, not a toy demo mode.
sandbox.point1: Same RulesEngine, same belief gate, same RiskManager
sandbox.point2: Simulated fills at observed market price, not idealized ones
sandbox.point3: A strategy's paper track record is what feeds its initial confidence

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.note: Not launched yet. Shown here as the planned structure, not a live offer. Nothing below is billable today.
pricing.planFreeBody: Dashboard read access, strategy layer, philosophy and engine docs. No live or paper trading.
pricing.planCoreBody: Paper trading, Telegram bot, full notification stream. Priced once the beta closes.
pricing.planLiveBody: Live broker connection, real capital. Gated behind a manual review, not self-serve.

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.a1: Not in the LLM or deep-learning sense. Rules come from trading literature, not a trained model. What updates statistically is confidence in each rule — bounded above and below so it never claims certainty.
faq.a2: MOEX via T-Invest (Tinkoff) and Finam, and crypto via Bybit. See the Broker Integrations section above.
faq.q3: Can I try it without risking money?
faq.a3: Yes. Paper trading runs the identical signal path against simulated fills. See Sandbox above.
faq.q4: What happens to a strategy that stops working?
faq.a4: It's frozen, not deleted or hidden. The Strategy Layer table shows FROZEN strategies with their real numbers, same as LIVE ones.
faq.a5: No. QuantFlow is in private beta. Pricing shown is the planned structure, not a current offer.
